name: Marbella Warm Modern
audience: Client exploring a luxury contemporary villa before committing to a full design brief
promise: Walk through a sequence of rooms, learn what you like, then transplant the look into your own project with real products and materials.

vibe_dna.lighting_character: low warm daylight with layered decorative lighting

guided_path.name: Arrival / first impression
guided_path.story_beat: Compression to reveal: stone, shadow, one sculptural light, almost no furniture.
guided_path.design_principle: Luxury through restraint and material scale rather than object count.

guided_path.name: Sunken living room
guided_path.story_beat: The hero social room: low cream upholstery, oak, stone, large rug and framed garden view.
guided_path.design_principle: Large calm forms + fewer better objects.

guided_path.name: Dining gallery
guided_path.story_beat: Long table, textured wall, pendant rhythm and a strong indoor/outdoor axis.
guided_path.design_principle: Repeat simple elements to create architectural rhythm.

guided_path.name: Primary suite
guided_path.story_beat: Softer and quieter: upholstered wall, warm oak, indirect light, stone bedside objects.
guided_path.design_principle: Reduce contrast and complexity as privacy increases.

guided_path.name: Stone bathroom
guided_path.story_beat: One material dominates, with precise bronze fittings and concealed services.
guided_path.design_principle: Continuous surfaces make small rooms feel monolithic and expensive.

guided_path.name: Pool terrace
guided_path.story_beat: Outdoor room rather than loose terrace furniture: shade, sofa, stone, planting, dining and water.
guided_path.design_principle: Treat exterior space with the same compositional discipline as interiors.

guided_path.name: New-material studio
guided_path.story_beat: Compare real stone/timber with lower-cost new systems such as flexible stone, WPC, SPC and PVC/UV stone-look sheet.
guided_path.design_principle: Preserve the visual intention while making material, cost, durability and compliance trade-offs explicit.
